examples.body:
[Paraphrase of recipient-published historical ORR correspondence; not a verbatim email. The original subject and delivery headers were not published.]

We acknowledge the appeal letter you copied to us about an unpaid-fares notice.

Penalty-fare schemes fall under the Department for Transport rather than our own regulatory responsibility. The department’s website provides the relevant rules.

If you remain dissatisfied with the appeal response, Passenger Focus may be able to approach the industry on your behalf. Questions about the regulation of these schemes can instead be addressed to the department.

We regret that we cannot take this matter forward, and hope these contacts help.

[Individual staff name and historical contact details omitted.]
